title: Disney at Christmas
titleTail: : Parties, Prices and the Cheapest Week to Go
h1: Disney at Christmas: your actual options at both resorts, and what they cost
description: Confirmed 2026–27 Disney holidays: both resorts begin November 13 and end January 6; Florida party dates and EPCOT festival dates differ.
summary: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort are confirmed for November 13, 2026 through January 6, 2027. Anaheim’s festival and overlays are included with park admission, while food and optional extras cost more. Walt Disney World’s 2026–27 holiday season has the same November 13–January 6 resort window, with Very Merry November 8–December 22, Jollywood November 7–January 5 and EPCOT Festival of the Holidays November 27–December 30.

typicalWindow.startsAround: November 13 at both resorts for their advertised 2026–27 holiday programs; Florida parties start November 7 and 8
typicalWindow.endsAround: January 6, 2027 at both resorts; Jollywood ends January 5

sections.heading: The short answer
body: For the 2026–27 Anaheim season, Disney confirms Holidays at the Disneyland Resort from November 13 through January 6. Book November 13 or later for the advertised holiday program and check the daily calendar for showtimes and ride operations.

For 2026–27, Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party has 25 select Magic Kingdom nights November 8–December 22, priced $189–$229 plus tax. Disney Jollywood Nights has 15 Hollywood Studios nights November 7–January 5, priced $169–$199 plus tax. EPCOT Festival of the Holidays runs November 27–December 30 with valid park admission.

The Disneyland Resort holiday program is included with regular park admission and a same-day reservation. It includes “it’s a small world” Holiday, Haunted Mansion Holiday, the two Cars Land overlays, A Christmas Fantasy Parade, holiday fireworks, World of Color – Season of Light and Disney Festival of Holidays. Festival food costs extra.

sections.heading: What the paid nights cost, and what they replace
body: The two 2026–27 Walt Disney World party schedules differ: Very Merry has 25 select nights November 8–December 22 at Magic Kingdom; Jollywood has 15 select nights November 7–January 5 at Hollywood Studios. Tickets cost $189–$229 and $169–$199, respectively, plus tax.

A valid party ticket admits guests early without a separate day ticket or park reservation: 4 p.m. for Very Merry and 5:30 p.m. for Jollywood. Both parties are separately ticketed; food and drink terms differ.

Very Merry is the family purchase: a parade, a fireworks show, and complimentary hot chocolate and cookies at stations around the park, in a Magic Kingdom running at a fraction of daytime capacity. Jollywood Nights is the adult purchase: it runs fewer nights, prices slightly lower, and trades the parade for lounge shows and a food-and-drink offering that is priced separately on top of the ticket. Do not buy Jollywood Nights expecting Very Merry with a different name.

Very Merry ends December 22. Jollywood has no dates December 24–January 2, then returns January 3 and 5. If you are traveling over Christmas week, check the exact date list before expecting a hard-ticket party.

sections.heading: The free layer, and why Anaheim wins it
body: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort run November 13, 2026–January 6, 2027, in both Anaheim parks. The four advertised ride overlays and major holiday entertainment are included with park admission; festival food and optional extras are separate purchases.

EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays is included with valid EPCOT admission November 27–December 30, 2026. Candlelight Processional viewing is included; food and optional dining packages cost extra. Food & Wine ends November 21, leaving November 22–26 without either festival.
Disneyland’s published holiday start is November 13, 2026. Do not use an early-November decoration glimpse as a promise that the full 2026–27 holiday program is operating before that date.

sections.heading: The cheapest week and the week to avoid
body: For Anaheim, the early part of the confirmed November 13–January 6 holiday program is a planning option before the late-December peak. Verify the daily calendar, because individual shows and attractions can vary even inside the event window.

The week between Christmas and New Year has no Very Merry or Jollywood party date in Disney’s published 2026–27 schedule. The wider Walt Disney World holiday program continues through January 6, and Jollywood returns January 3 and 5.

The Disneyland Resort season ends January 6, 2027. Early-January trips can still overlap the holiday program, but only through that confirmed end date, and individual attraction availability should be checked.

sections.heading: Booking order and sell-out risk
body: Book in this order: the party night first, the hotel second, the flights third. Very Merry and Jollywood Nights tickets have historically gone on sale in the summer for the following winter, with an annual passholder and Disney Vacation Club presale ahead of general sale. December weekend nights sell out; November midweek nights rarely do.

Candlelight Processional dining packages at EPCOT sell out further ahead than the party tickets do, particularly for the narrator names that draw a crowd. If a specific narrator is the point of the trip, that booking drives your dates.
Disney has published the 2026–27 Walt Disney World party, EPCOT festival and resort-wide holiday dates. Confirm ticket availability and daily entertainment on each official event page before booking.

sections.heading: Which resort to pick for the holidays
body: Pick the Disneyland Resort for the holiday season itself and Walt Disney World for a holiday party. Anaheim converts more of its parks for longer, includes all of it in the ticket, and keeps the season running into January. Orlando has the better single evening for sale and a much larger trip to build around it.

The cost difference is real. At Disney’s published 2026 Very Merry prices, two adult tickets and two tickets for children ages 3–9 cost $736–$896 before tax, depending on the night. Disneyland Resort holiday entertainment is included with regular admission, although food and optional extras still cost more.

For adults considering Jollywood, Disney’s 2026–27 ticket band is $169–$199 plus tax. Very Merry costs $189–$229 plus tax and has more family-focused parade and fireworks content. Your exact travel dates decide which is available.

walt-disney-world.verdict: Early November, one party night, and EPCOT for the food. Avoid the last week of December entirely.
walt-disney-world.note: The official 2026–27 Walt Disney World holiday season runs November 13–January 6. Very Merry: 25 select nights November 8–December 22, $189–$229 plus tax, ticket entry 4 p.m. Jollywood: 15 select nights November 7–January 5, $169–$199 plus tax, ticket entry 5:30 p.m. EPCOT Festival of the Holidays: November 27–December 30, included with valid EPCOT admission. No party dates are listed December 24–January 2; Jollywood returns January 3 and 5.

disneyland.verdict: The best free seasonal product either company runs. No party ticket exists and none is needed.
disneyland.note: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort are confirmed November 13, 2026–January 6, 2027. The two parks offer “it’s a small world” Holiday, Haunted Mansion Holiday, the two Cars Land ride overlays, A Christmas Fantasy Parade, holiday fireworks and World of Color – Season of Light. Disney Festival of Holidays and Disney ¡Viva Navidad! share the same window at DCA; food costs extra, and its street party performances are advertised on Saturdays and Sundays.

faqs.q: Is there a Christmas party at Disneyland?
faqs.a: No, and there never has been an equivalent of Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party in Anaheim. The Disneyland Resort puts its holiday content into an overlay across both parks that is included with any ticket. Disneyland After Dark runs separate hard-ticket evenings through parts of the year, but none of them is a holiday party in the Florida sense.

faqs.q: When do the decorations go up and come down?
faqs.a: Disneyland Resort’s advertised 2026–27 holiday program runs November 13, 2026 through January 6, 2027. Check Disney’s daily calendar for specific decorations, entertainment and attraction operations. Walt Disney World follows its own schedule.

faqs.q: Do the parties run over Christmas week?
faqs.a: Neither Very Merry nor Jollywood lists a date December 24–January 2 in the published 2026–27 schedule. Very Merry ends December 22; Jollywood returns January 3 and 5. The broader Walt Disney World holiday season continues through January 6.

Very Merry runs 25 select Magic Kingdom nights November 8–December 22, 2026, at $189–$229 plus tax, with parade and fireworks. Jollywood runs 15 select Hollywood Studios nights November 7–January 5 at $169–$199 plus tax, with event entertainment, characters and PhotoPass downloads; specialty food and drinks cost extra. Choose by your dates and priorities.

faqs.q: Is the Candlelight Processional worth a dining package?
faqs.a: Only if the narrator matters to you or you were eating a table-service meal at EPCOT that evening anyway. The show itself is free to watch — the package buys guaranteed seating, not access. Packages sell out well before party tickets do for the better-known narrators, so if that is the deciding factor it should be your first booking rather than your last.

faqs.q: Are the Disneyland 2026–27 holiday dates confirmed?
faqs.a: Yes. Disney confirms November 13, 2026–January 6, 2027 for Holidays at the Disneyland Resort, Disney Festival of Holidays and Disney ¡Viva Navidad! Disney’s earlier November 18 start was officially corrected to November 13 on July 24, 2026.
